description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 496df8b1 = MAIN-READY-113 caf9c693, v2-16400) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md step 1, section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducers, run on the tree with `pcl`, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    use bigint try => "Calc";        # also: use bigint lib => "Calc";
    print 3**50, "\n";
    perl: 717897987691852588770249
    PCL : dies at the use, exit 255:
          "try" is not exported by the bigint module
          "Calc" is not exported by the bigint module
          Can't continue after import errors at .../lib/bigint.pm line 38.

    use bignum qw(e PI);
    print substr(e, 0, 12), " ", substr(PI, 0, 12), "\n";
    perl: 2.7182818284 3.1415926535
    PCL : "e" is not exported by the bignum module / "PI" is not exported by the bignum module / Can't continue after import errors at .../lib/bignum.pm line 36.

WHERE: lib/bigint.pm `sub import` installs the constant handlers and then calls `__PACKAGE__->export_to_level(1, @_)` with ALL of its arguments; @EXPORT is `inf NaN hex oct` and there is no @EXPORT_OK.  perl's bigint / bignum take the options `try` / `lib` / `only` (a math library; Calc is the pure-Perl one PCL runs anyway), `a` / `p` / `accuracy` / `precision`, `upgrade` / `downgrade`, `l` / `t` / `v` (short forms) out of the list before exporting, and bignum exports `e`, `PI`, `bexp`, `bpi` on request.  The fix is in the two shims (rule 9a: module behaviour, lib/ layer): consume the option pairs, and give both shims the four on-request functions perl 5.40.3 lists in @EXPORT_OK (bigint.pm: `PI e bpi bexp hex oct`) over Math::BigFloat->bexp / bpi.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): each of the four programs with ONLY the import spelling patched (`use bigint try => "GMP"` -> `use bigint`; `use bignum qw(e)` -> `use bignum` and the one `e` call removed) is byte-identical to perl -- the import is each program's only cause.  (Run with the tree's `pcl` driver: `./runpcl` recompiles Math::BigInt / BigFloat from text and needs 28-54 s a run, `pcl` 0.1 s warm -- #5127's note.)

PROGRAMS: 0033-Ackermann-function, 0715-Knuths-power-tree, 0998-Pells-equation (try => 'GMP'), 0161-Calculating-the-value-of-e (bignum qw(e)).
subject: LOUD: `use bigint` / `use bignum` die at IMPORT on perl's documented options and on-request exports -- `use bigint try => "GMP"` (also `lib =>`, `only =>`) and `use bignum qw(e PI)` die "\"try\" is not exported by the bigint module" / "\"e\" is not exported by the bignum module": lib/bigint.pm's and lib/bignum.pm's import hands every argument to Exporter (Rosetta 0033 0715 0998 0161)
triage_reason: bigint / bignum are shipped shims, IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3; the options and the e / PI exports are perl's documented interface (perldoc bigint, bignum)
